user.title: Connect DecisionNode
user.description: DecisionNode is a decision engine. Paste an API key from your DecisionNode console.

data_description.api_key: Kept in this integration's configuration and never written to the log.
data_description.model: decisionnode-moe, or decisionnode-flash for the fast, lower-cost model.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect DecisionNode
reauth_confirm.description: DecisionNode refused the API key. Paste a valid key.

abort.already_configured: This API key is already set up.

init.title: Standing questions and Frigate
init.description: Standing questions are asked on a schedule and show up as sensors. The Frigate trigger asks its questions when Frigate detects something.

error.standing_not_a_list: Standing questions must be a list.
error.standing_invalid: A standing question needs a name, a question with a type and instructions, and at most one of camera and image_url; interval is at least 10 seconds.
error.standing_duplicate_name: Two standing questions have the same name.
error.standing_type: A standing question is a truth, choice, score or number question.
error.frigate_invalid: The Frigate settings are not valid.
error.frigate_incomplete: The Frigate trigger needs frigate_url and at least one question.

decide.name: Decide
decide.description: Ask DecisionNode one or more questions about a camera's picture, an image or a state.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The DecisionNode account to use. Left out: the first one.

camera_entity_id.name: Camera
camera_entity_id.description: The camera whose current picture is decided.

image_url.name: Image URL
image_url.description: An https URL of a picture, fetched by DecisionNode.

image_path.name: Image path
image_path.description: A picture file Home Assistant may read (allowlist_external_dirs).

questions.name: Questions
questions.description: Questions by id, each with a type (truth, choice, score, number, point, box) and instructions, as the DecisionNode API takes them.

state.name: State
state.description: Text or data the questions are about, beside the picture.

model.name: Model
model.description: The model for this call. Left out: the account's model.
